heard: Pharaoh named him Zephanet-Paneah Gave him Azaneth, daughter of Petiphar Priest of Onn, a wife of Grace Joseph stood before the king Thirty years old in that land He left the palace, traveled on May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh Blessed with names that carry on Inheritance equal sons of Israel Adopted in the covenant home Before the famine came to pass Two sons were born in the land
